summary: Charlotte Melina Viall studied at the Cornell University College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (~1910–1914) and at the University of Chicago.

Charlotte Vaudeville was an Indologist and religious studies scholar educated at the Sorbonne and École des chartes, studying under Pierre Meile, Theodor Bloch, Louis Renou, and Dhirendra Varma. She held posts at CNRS, EFEO, EPHE, and the Sorbonne.

Chatral Sangye Dorje was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar. He studied under numerous teachers, including Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang and Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje, whom he also succeeded, and taught Keith Dowman and Gyurme Dorje, among others.

Chatsumarn Kabilsingh is a Buddhist studies, philosophy, and religious studies scholar who earned degrees from Visva-Bharati, McMaster, and Magadh Universities. She taught at Thammasat University (~1973–2000) and founded Yasodhara and the Sakyadhita International Association of Buddhist Women.

Chen-kuo Lin is a philosopher and Buddhist studies scholar who completed his degree at Temple University in 1991. He served as Professor and Distinguished Professor at National Chengchi University, and held posts at IIAS and Leiden University.
Cheng Huang has held academic posts at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, UT Southwestern Medical Center, and Southern Methodist University.
Cheng Yen is a religious studies and Buddhist studies figure who studied under Yinshun in 1963. She founded the Tzu Chi Foundation in 1966 and Tzu Chi University in 2000.
Cheryl A. Crowley is a Japanology scholar who studied under Linda H. Chance, William R. LaFleur, Philip Boas Yampolsky, and Ryuichi Abe.

Chhabilal Neupane works in Indology and philosophy, earning an MA in Hindi from IGNOU (2023–2024). He taught Sanskrit at Union Academy Senior Secondary School (2019–2023) and held a post in Darshan at Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University (2023).

Chheangkhy Hok works in linguistics and Indology, holding appointments at the University of Heng Samrin Thbongkhmum in the Department of Khmer Literature and at the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi.
Chhime Rigdzing was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje and held a post at Visva-Bharati University.

Chhimed Rigdzin was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied with and taught Choying Khyabdel. He conducted research at the Italian Institute for the Middle and Far East (~1955–1957) and was Professor of Tibetan at Visva-Bharati University (~1957–1987).

Chi Chen Ho is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who studied under traditional teacher Hsuan Hua and doctoral supervisor Robert E. Buswell Jr., completing a PhD at UCLA in 2010 while serving there as a teaching assistant.

Chi-chiang Huang is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Sinology, and history and archaeology. He earned a PhD from the University of Arizona in 1986 under doctoral supervisor Jing-shen Tao and studied with Robert M. Gimello.

Chi-wah Chan is a Buddhist studies and Sinology scholar who studied under Robert E. Buswell Jr. and Benjamin A. Elman, completing a PhD at UCLA in 1993. Chan also served as a teaching assistant at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Chia Theng Shen was active in Buddhist studies. He founded the Institute for Advanced Studies of World Religions and served at the Buddhist Association of the United States from circa 1964 to 2007.
Chie Ikeya is a historian and archaeologist who earned a PhD at Cornell University in 2006, where she studied under David K. Wyatt.
Chien Y. Hsu is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under doctoral supervisors Leslie S. Kawamura and James B. Apple, and under traditional teacher Zhenhua.

Chien-hsing Ho is a scholar of philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He held an appointment as Associate Professor of Religious Studies at Nanhua University (attested 2014) and a post at Academia Sinica (attested 2018).

Chienlin Lee earned a PhD at National Dong Hwa University (2009–2020). He served as Adjunct Assistant Professor at National Taitung University (2020–2022), Project Assistant Professor at NDHU (2022–2023), and Postdoctoral Fellow at Academia Sinica (2023).
